item.text: {"0":"Increase embedding width by one modest supported step, keeping the incumbent head count, depth and optimization settings fixed. Preserve divisibility by the head count and update predictor generation consistently. Wider representations may improve item discrimination, particularly for Electronics, the weakest category. Assess macro validation HR@10 and per-category regressions.","1":"Increase weight decay modestly while preserving all other incumbent settings. Electronics validation peaks before declining, suggesting stronger regularization may improve generalization; CDs_and_Vinyl continues improving late, so avoid a large increase that could cause underfitting. Evaluate the tradeoff using macro validation HR@10 across all four categories.","2":"Increase attention heads by the next supported step dividing the current embedding width, holding width, depth and training settings fixed. Prior increases showed positive validation support, including the latest +0.0200 macro HR@10 gain. Test whether further attention specialization helps while monitoring Electronics and preserving the other categories. Keep predictor generation consistent.","3":"Increase maximum sequence length modestly, leaving architecture and optimization settings otherwise fixed. Additional history may capture longer-term preferences and improve the weaker Electronics results, though older interactions could introduce noise. Preserve truncation and padding consistency in the predictor writer, and assess the change using macro validation HR@10 and per-category results."}
